name: Ethena USDtb
oneLiner: USDtb is Ethena's T-Bill-backed stablecoin, holding BlackRock's BUIDL fund as primary reserves; designed as a calmer alternative to USDe.
collateral: ~99% BlackRock USD Institutional Digital Liquidity Fund (BUIDL), investing in cash, U.S. Treasury Bills/Notes, and repurchase agreements; remainder in cash at FDIC-insured major commercial banks; issued by Anchorage Digital Bank N.A.; reserves held in segregated fiduciary trust accounts for the benefit of USDtb holders, with BUIDL self-custodied by Anchorage in segregated wallets (May 2026 Deloitte-examined reserve report)
pegMechanism: Direct 1:1 mint and redemption; BUIDL shares redeemable 24/7 via atomic swap with Securitize; LayerZero OFT cross-chain transfers

proofOfReserves.provider: Big Four accounting firm via Anchorage Digital Bank

applicabilityBasis.summary: USDtb is publicly described as a U.S. dollar-backed stablecoin issued by Anchorage Digital Bank against BUIDL and cash reserves.

genius.notes: Anchorage Digital Bank N.A. is an OCC-chartered uninsured national trust bank — not a deposit-taking IDI, not a state entity. Under the GENIUS Act's taxonomy, this places it in the federal-qualified nonbank issuer (FQPSI) pathway supervised by the OCC. In its comment letter to the OCC's GENIUS Act NPRM (2026), Anchorage stated it 'expects to become a permitted payment stablecoin issuer (PPSI) pursuant to the GENIUS Act, once effective' — forward-looking intent, not a current approval. No PPSI approvals have been granted to any issuer as of 2026-06-18; the PPSI approval framework remains in proposed-rules phase (OCC NPRM issued Feb 2026, final rules not yet published). issuerPathway corrected from unknown to federal-qualified-nonbank based on Anchorage's OCC national trust bank charter.

mintAuthority.summary: USDtb is issued by Anchorage Digital Bank against BUIDL/cash reserves. Ethereum issuance uses a MINTER_BURNER_ROLE and immediate proxy admin controlled by issuer EOAs; the native Solana Token-2022 mint has a distinct wallet authority. LayerZero OFT routes are reviewed separately as bridge controls.

controls.label: USDtb MINTER_BURNER_ROLE holder
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25294739, hasRole(MINTER_BURNER_ROLE=0xcfd53186, 0x364366) returned true. eth_getCode returned empty (EOA confirmed). This is the sole active MINTER_BURNER_ROLE holder per Blockscout RoleGranted/RoleRevoked log scan from block 21287284. Issuer-operated model corroborated by USDtb docs (Anchorage Digital Bank).

controls.label: USDtb DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holder
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25526176, hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, 0xd93826BB299765c87D13AeBa2A7E5d9B27A03956) returned true and token owner() returned the same EOA. The token's EIP-1967 admin slot resolves to verified ProxyAdmin 0x3c405f68d5c6ece868e5646cac926679839acd68, whose owner() is this EOA; the implementation slot resolves to AnchorageTokenUSDtb 0x9D6d77a21702b9AFcF924983fbFB84AAAAe79589. The EOA can grant or revoke MINTER_BURNER_ROLE and execute immediate ProxyAdmin upgrades; no on-chain timelock applies.

controls.label: USDtb Solana Token-2022 mint and permanent-delegate authority
controls.evidence: At finalized Solana slot 432721335, the official Token-2022 mint reports this address as both mintAuthority and permanentDelegate. At slot 432721398 the authority account was system-program-owned, non-executable, and zero-data, confirming an externally controlled wallet. No mint cap is encoded.

review.evidence: Ethereum reads at block 25526176 resolve the active MINTER_BURNER_ROLE holder, DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holder, transparent-proxy implementation, ProxyAdmin, and immediate ProxyAdmin owner. Anchorage's March 2026 attestation identifies Ethereum and Solana as native USDtb deployments; finalized Solana reads at slot 432721335 resolve the mint and permanent-delegate authority to an externally controlled wallet. LayerZero OFT ownership is handled by the separate bridge-route review.

reserves.name: BlackRock BUIDL (U.S. T-Bills, cash, repos)
reserves.issuerOrObligor: BlackRock USD Institutional Digital Liquidity Fund

reserveReview.rationale: The current issuer endpoint reports BUIDL held at the published Anchorage custody address plus assetsInMotion, and the transparency dashboard presents assetsInMotion as USD. The BUIDL row is linked to the tracked fund; the settlement-float counterparty and timing remain undisclosed.
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The assets-in-motion USD settlement float has no disclosed banking counterparty or settlement timing.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: The issuer reports this amount as USD assets in motion but does not identify its banking counterparty or settlement timeline.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Anchorage reports that BUIDL is self-custodied in segregated wallets and cash is held in segregated fiduciary trust accounts at major commercial banks. The banks are not identified, current provider allocations can change, and the legal treatment has not been independently adjudicated.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: USDtb uses or is linked to LayerZero/OFT-style cross-chain token infrastructure. Because OFT/adapter routes depend on external messaging, endpoint configuration, and lock/mint or burn/mint token contracts outside issuer-native redemption alone, Pharos scores the reviewed route as external lock/mint.
